speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML). The MRI findings of multifocal demyelinating lesions without enhancement, combined with your history of immunosuppression, are diagnostic. We should immediately evaluate your current medication regimen for agents that cause immunosuppression, such as natalizumab or rituximab.
